```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(manipulate)
read.csv("loan_cleaned.csv") -> loan
read.csv("C:\\Users\\iamas\\OneDrive\\Documents\\GitHub\\Data_324_FinalProject\\loan_cleaned.csv") -> loan
```

```{r}
loan <- loan %>%
  mutate(loan_status=if_else(loan_status==1, "Approved", "Rejected"))
```

```{r}
manipulate(
  ggplot(
    loan %>% filter(person_age==AGE),
    aes(x=person_income, y=credit_score)
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color=loan_status), alpha=1, size=1) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(5000, 1000000), ylim=c(390, 784)) +
#    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(8000, 2448661), ylim=c(390, 784)) +
    labs(title="Income vs Credit Score", x="Annual Income ($)", y="Credit Score"),
  
  AGE=slider(21, 40, initial=25, label="Age")
)
```


```{r}
manipulate(
  ggplot(
    loan %>% filter(person_age==AGE)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x=income_group, y=loan_amnt, fill=loan_status)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(500, 35000)) +
    labs(title="Distributions of Requested Loan Amounts by Approval Status Across Income Groups", x="Income Group", y="Loan Amount ($)"),
  
  AGE=slider(21, 40, initial=25, label="Age")
)
```
